description: Sonic 3 & Knuckles website hero loop: AIZ loop opening, zones in game order with bonus and special stages, rewind and Data Select mid-reel, donation shots last; hard cuts, fade at the loop ends.

shots.label: Angel Island Act 1: through the loop
Angel Island Act 1: flame craft
Blue Spheres special stage from the Angel Island giant ring
shots.note: Declared position beside the AIZ2 giant ring the complete-run movie enters; authored entry and stage turns (inputs/s3k-aiz2-special-ring.script). Following the complete-run movie from the AIZ1 level start drifts: the direct boot's spindash release differs from the post-intro recording, and a teleport into the AIZ1 lower cave dies below the event-owned camera bound.

shots.label: Hydrocity Act 1: a Sonic chain in the water current and the rising water wall
shots.note: Declared position at hcz_completerun row 2840 (movie frame 27170 + 2840), where the complete-run movie swims into the S-shaped tube and rides the geyser; three Sonic sidekicks follow the leader. The leader stays on the trace's line through the geyser (checked every 40 frames).

shots.label: Hydrocity Act 1: whirlpool miniboss
Marble Garden Act 1: drill miniboss
Carnival Night Act 1: barber-pole slide and spinning cylinder
Gumball Machine bonus stage
IceCap Act 1: snowboard
Angel Island Act 2: a bomb hits, live rewind undoes it
shots.note: Declared position before the bombing run with the 72 rings the complete-run movie carries there. A bomb hits at frame 576; the held rewind key (630:90) restores the pre-hit state; authored jumps then clear the bombs.

shots.label: Launch Base Act 1: results
Data Select: saves with custom teams
shots.note: Declared Data Select setup: six generated save slots with custom teams, zones and emeralds (inputs/s3k-data-select-saves.json) and three extra team combos; the cursor walks the saves and cycles the NEW slot's team (inputs/s3k-data-select-teams.script).

shots.label: Mushroom Hill Act 1: pulleys and forest
Flying Battery Act 2: lightning shield
Glowing Spheres bonus stage
Sandopolis Act 1: desert loop
Lava Reef: boss over the lava
shots.note: hpz22_completerun is zone $16: the Lava Reef boss act, then Hidden Palace. The lrz_completerun replay loses Sonic before its fast sections.

shots.label: Hidden Palace: Eggman steals the Master Emerald
shots.note: Direct Hidden Palace boot following the complete-run movie from the act's start (movie frame 380459 + trace row 9462); it matches the trace's positions through frame 6600. The trace replay itself diverges before this act.

shots.label: Sky Sanctuary Act 1
Death Egg Act 1: a lift pad rides the light rail
shots.note: ssz_completerun is zone $0B, Death Egg; this early window replays cleanly.

shots.label: Death Egg Act 2: a Sonic chain runs in reversed gravity
shots.note: Direct Death Egg 2 boot following the complete-run movie from the act's control release (ssz_completerun row 19273); the gravity flips are the act's own gravity switches. A sidekick change leaves the recorded line after a few seconds, so the window stays early.

shots.label: Doomsday: Super Sonic chases the Eggman ship
shots.note: Committed DDZ route with the seven Chaos Emeralds it declares. Doomsday spawns no sidekicks, so a Sonic chain is not available here.

shots.label: Sonic 2 donating: Super Sonic on the Mushroom Hill springs
shots.note: Declared position at mhz_completerun row 4900 (movie frame 209756 + 4900), seven emeralds and 60 rings; with Sonic 2 donating, the movie's next jump transforms him through Sonic 2's Super rules and he bounces on the mushroom springs.

shots.label: Sonic 1 donating: Sonic rolls under the Flying Battery elevator
shots.note: Declared position right of the descending $0DC0 elevator, the Sonic 1 donation challenge recorded on 2026-09-14. Sonic 1 has no spindash, so he runs left and rolls under the cars between their descents (inputs/s3k-fbz2-s1-elevator.script). The fbz_completerun movie passes this x on the upper path about 5,700 frames (1:35) into act 2 with 43 rings, and those values are declared here. The neutral lead-in sets the elevator phase.
